title: Strider Striders
description: Retextures all striders to more resemble certain characters from a certain webcomic. Several different configurations are available, depending on version.
body:
There are two versions for 1.21.1: a Dave version and a Dirk Version. In my experience they should work for any version between 1.20 and 1.21.11.  

There are four versions for 26.1: 
- A Dave Version
- A Dirk version
- A "Beta timeline" version (the adult strider uses the Dirk texture and the baby strider uses 
  the Dave texture)
- An "Alpha timeline" version (the adult strider uses the Dave texture and the baby strider 
  uses the Dirk texture)
